label: Information Content Entity
description: BFO: Generically Dependent Continuant — copyable information content whose identity is the pattern, not the carrier.

label: Non-Sensitive Data
description: Data not requiring elevated protection. Internal operational or structural information.

label: Sensitive Data
description: Data requiring protection due to privacy, regulatory, or business sensitivity.

label: Personally Identifiable Data
description: Data relating to an identified or identifiable natural person.

label: Contact Information
description: Information used to contact a person.

label: Email Address
description: An electronic mail address for a person.

label: Phone Number
description: A telephone number for contacting a person.

label: Mailing Address
description: A physical postal address.

label: Identity Information
description: Data that identifies a specific person.

label: Full Name
description: A person's complete legal name.

label: Date of Birth
description: The date on which a person was born.

label: Government Identifier
description: A government-issued identifier (SSN, passport, driver's license).
common_names: SSN, social security, tax id, passport number

label: Financial Data
description: Data relating to financial accounts or transactions.

label: Payment Card Number
description: A credit or debit card primary account number.
common_names: PAN, credit card, card number, CC number

label: Bank Account Number
description: A unique identifier for a bank account.

label: Transaction Amount
description: The monetary value of a financial transaction.

label: Technical Data
description: Data relating to technical systems and infrastructure.

label: IP Address
description: An Internet Protocol address identifying a device on a network.

label: Device Identifier
description: A unique identifier for a computing device.
common_names: UUID, MAC address, device ID, serial number

label: URL
description: A Uniform Resource Locator identifying a web resource.

label: Metadata
description: Data about data — timestamps, identifiers, and structural information.

label: Timestamp
description: A date and/or time value recording when an event occurred.

label: Record Identifier
description: A unique key identifying a database record.
common_names: ID, primary key, row ID, record ID

label: Status Code
description: A categorical value indicating the state of a record.
